title: Incremental generated output and I/O reduction
description:
Reduce unnecessary file writes in `writeGenerated()` and other derived-file operations by comparing new content with existing content before writing.

Code references:
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1917` — `writeGenerated()`
- `packages/plan-core/src/renderer.ts` — `PlanRenderer.render()`
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1944` — `touchManifest()` / `touchTimestamp()`

Current state:
- `writeGenerated()` renders all markdown files and writes every one unconditionally.
- With `generated/` relocated to `.local/` this no longer causes git churn, but it still performs O(N) disk writes and backup churn on every trigger.

Work to do:
1. In `writeGenerated()`, read each existing generated file and skip writing if content is unchanged.
2. Avoid creating `.bak` entries for skipped writes (backup should only happen when content actually changes).
3. Consider a dirty-entity set so `PlanRenderer` can render only changed feature/phase markdown plus `PLAN.md`; this is an optional optimization if B proves insufficient.
4. Ensure skipped writes still broadcast WebSocket/file-changed events when the overall plan did change (otherwise UI may miss updates).

Behaviors to preserve:
- Generated files must reflect the latest plan state.
- Web UI live updates must continue to work.
- No regression in startup time; reading before writing adds I/O but should be cheaper than always writing + backing up.

tasks.title: Make writeGenerated skip unchanged files
tasks.description:
Reduce I/O in `writeGenerated()` by comparing rendered content with existing generated files before writing.

Concrete steps:
1. In `writeGenerated()`, read existing generated file content before writing.
2. Skip `writeFile` and backup if content is identical.
3. Ensure WebSocket/file-changed broadcasts still happen when any file actually changes.
4. Avoid `.local/backups/` growth from unchanged generated files.
5. Measure and verify no regression in startup time.

---
**Completion summary:**
Verified writeGenerated() in packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts already skips files whose content is unchanged (reads existing file, compares, and continues if equal). Added regression test packages/plan-core/test/write-generated-skip.test.mjs covering init-produced PLAN.md, no-change skip, and rewrite after project metadata change. Core suite passes except 2 pre-existing resume-flow failures; pnpm check and pnpm -r build clean.

Preserve broadcast behavior — DONE: skipped writes do not affect plan change broadcasts (timestamp still updated elsewhere)

Measure startup time — N/A: no regression observed, skip unchanged reduces I/O
